classification: outcome-free exact-moment feasibility scan; not sampled or formal evidence

actions.catalogue: local plus each of three single donors at each registered nonzero alpha

analysis.primary_risk: mean personalized parameter MSE averaged over all 24 blocks
analysis.strong_static_graph: cellwise best of all 7^4 time-invariant recipient-specific donor/action graphs, with no sensing charge
analysis.dynamic_oracle: fully probe-charged exact checkpoint risk minimizer relative to the same-data local shadow
analysis.single_switch_schedule: A for blocks 0-11 and B for blocks 12-23
analysis.alternating_schedule: A for blocks 0-7, B for blocks 8-15, and A for blocks 16-23

mandatory_gates.R1: all 432 cells and 1037232 static graph risks are finite and positive
mandatory_gates.R2: dynamic oracle is no worse than its fully charged local shadow at every decision checkpoint
mandatory_gates.R3: probe transitions are fully charged and every dynamic policy uses exactly 240 environment transitions
mandatory_gates.R4: every dynamic policy satisfies the 18-unit message budget
mandatory_gates.R5: on the 288 nonstationary cells, dynamic oracle improves aggregate geometric cumulative risk over the best static graph by at least 5%
mandatory_gates.R6: dynamic oracle strictly improves at least 60% of nonstationary cells
mandatory_gates.R7: dynamic oracle improves each nonstationary schedule family by at least 3%
mandatory_gates.R8: dynamic oracle has nonnegative aggregate improvement in every delay group
mandatory_gates.R9: dynamic oracle changes its graph at least once in at least 60% of nonstationary cells
mandatory_gates.R10: stationary-control aggregate improvement is at most 5%
mandatory_gates.R11: at least eight distinct best static graphs are selected
mandatory_gates.R12: a clean deterministic rerun is byte-identical
